metadata.description: Marketplace for two Product Backlog skills: a markdown-table backlog with HTML dashboard, and a JSON-backed backlog with a strict schema and a live HTML editor, both driven from Claude session activity.

plugins.name: product-backlog
plugins.description: Analyzes the current Claude session — git commits, plans, PRDs, opportunities-marked-DONE, conversational signals — and updates docs/backlog/product-backlog.md with atomic rows, status sections, stable IDs, and append-only artifact links. Also bootstraps a self-contained HTML dashboard (regenerated only on template version bumps) and offers a commit/push prompt at the end. Bundles a second skill, new-product-backlog, which keeps a strict JSON-Schema-validated docs/backlog/product-backlog.json, mutated only through a pure-stdlib Python CLI (init/add/edit/discard/rm/get/list/validate), with a live localhost HTML editor for manual add/edit/filter/search.
